entityOverrides.description: Verified the admin root route through authenticated production clickthrough evidence on 2026-06-27 and 2026-06-29: /admin resolved to the expected admin destination after middleware and app routing. A fresh local synthetic-cookie CDP precheck on 2026-07-15 confirmed that this harness does not emulate an ADMIN principal and therefore cannot replace authenticated admin route proof.

Verified the admin users route wrapper through a local authenticated admin browser proof on 2026-07-15: /admin/users rendered the expected operator surface with admin and regular user rows, role controls, subscription-plan controls, refresh, and filters. Fresh 2026-07-15 readback also confirmed unauthenticated route access still fails closed with HTTP 307 to /auth/login, and focused AdminUsersPage component tests passed without submitting admin mutations.

Verified the AdminUsersPage operator surface through the same-day local authenticated admin browser proof on 2026-07-15: /admin/users rendered admin and regular user rows, role action controls, subscription-plan controls, refresh, and filters without submitting admin mutations. Fresh 2026-07-15 focused component tests also passed for load, role confirmation, plan assignment confirmation, cancel path, and load-error rendering.
